summary: Tested Conversion & ROI features for Stratégie & Expertise Santé admin dashboard. All 11 backend tests passed. All 14 frontend tests passed. Features working: 1) PATCH /api/admin/contacts/{id} accepts status=converti with conversion_montant, conversion_prestation, conversion_date, 2) GET /api/admin/stats returns converti count and total_revenue, 3) GET /api/tracking/conversion-analytics returns channels with conversions/revenue/close_rate and prestations array, 4) Admin contacts tab shows 5 KPI cards including Convertis with revenue, 5) Contact detail modal has Converti button with emerald styling, 6) Conversion form appears with montant and prestation fields, 7) Converted contacts show conversion info block with montant/prestation/date, 8) Analytics tab shows Conversions & ROI section with revenue per channel.
